Deep nesting is handled safely.

Now let me test with a large valid input close to 8MiB (lots of whitespace) to check memory/time. Actually, the max request is bounded: 6 cases × 256 events, 384 events total. A large input could have lots of whitespace padding. Let me test with ~8MiB of whitespace inside a valid request.

Actually, "At most 8MiB stdin, including whitespace, is in the execution domain". Let me test a valid request padded with whitespace to ~7MB.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$PWD/native PYTHONPATH=$PWD/.deps OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 && python3 -c "
import json,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'dev')
import gen, random
req = gen.make_request(random.Random(7), cases=2, big=True)
s = json.dumps(req, indent=3)
# pad with lots of whitespace inside the JSON text
s = s.replace('\n', '\n'+' '*200)
print(len(s), file=sys.stderr)
sys.stdout.write(s)
" > /tmp/big.json 2>/tmp/big.err; cat /tmp/big.err; ls -l /tmp/big.json; time (python3 submission/main.py < /tmp/big.json | head -c 200; echo)
